title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10316)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the definitions and symbol of basic module and sub-modular increments for modular co-ordination of building, for their constituent parts and for the building components used in their constituent parts and for the building components used in their construction, and also recommends their values.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
